Corollary
[Poincare Conjecture and spherical space-form conjecture] ↗ thm:classification-fundamental-group-free-product

Every closed simply connected $3$-manifold is diffeomorphic to $S^3$, and every closed $3$-manifold with finite fundamental group is diffeomorphic to a $3$-dimensional spherical space-form.
